items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury; team optimistic after feeling better Saturday.
items.why: McVay called calf minor; no setbacks; confirmed active by Schefter, Rapoport, Berry, ETR.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1/2; Adams already out long-term boosts target share.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets/red-zone with Davante Adams out 6-10 weeks.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT (high ankle sprain). Tyler Huntley expected to start again for Ravens.
items.why: Downgraded from Q; confirmed multiple sources including Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Fade Ravens pass game volume; Huntley limited upside.
items.opportunity: Potential uptick for Derrick Henry, Zay Flowers, Mark Andrews in run-heavy script.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall unlikely then confirmed inactive (quad); not full participant, bit early in return after missing 3 games.
items.why: Sources: may workout but early; Schefter listed inactive with Ridley.
items.implication: Sit; Braelon Allen or committee lead.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for Jets RBs (Allen primary).

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected lead back and produced 124y/1TD but Levitan thinks actually hurt (hamstring); confirmed felt something, slid, bye helps. Not certain severity.
items.why: Postgame confirmation of hamstring feel on OT run; ETR watching; Rapoport pregame lead expected + tally.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 9; bye cushions; Tracy/Singletary beneficiaries if misses.
items.opportunity: Prior lead role validated by production; reverse if out.
items.conflict: Berry pregame HATE on tough matchup, but usage strong.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs turned ankle on purposeful slide but almost certainly fine; would be tilting if serious from smart non-TD.
items.why: ETR watching list; Levitan player-specific conclusion post-slide.
items.implication: No major downgrade ROS/weekly; monitor Monday reports.
items.opportunity: Maintains RB1 role/snaps/routes in DET offense.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (Q but in line) vs DAL on MNF; efficient in prior full games.
items.why: Full practice context; Berry also notes in line to play, great DAL matchup.
items.implication: Start as RB1/2 if confirmed active.
items.opportunity: Workload + matchup vs soft DAL run D.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT; Saquon expected, impacts PHI pass game vs DAL.
items.why: Injury report confirmed; Rapoport noted Smith out.
items.implication: Fade remaining PHI WRs somewhat; boost TE/Goedert and Saquon.
items.opportunity: Target/route share to Dallas Goedert, AJ Brown (if playing), residual WRs.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt; expected to play Sunday at DET in season debut/return.
items.why: Activated and expected; ETR listed IN.
items.implication: RB2/flex but monitor snaps post-layoff; Berry hates workload uncertainty.
items.opportunity: Lead back role vs DET; handcuff Wilson drops.
items.conflict: Berry HATE due to layoff rust vs volume expectation.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey (quad) went to locker then returned to game; watching but played through.
items.why: Schefter confirmed return after locker room; ETR watching list.
items.implication: Minimal long-term concern with bye upcoming; maintains elite role.
items.opportunity: Continued snaps/routes/carries; WR injuries tempt more slot but Levitan skeptical historically.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, usage/matchup vs Bears good for yardage.
items.why: Usage rebound + Bears secondary allows yardage; elite volume context with Smith out later.
items.opportunity: Target share expansion with teammates out.

items.text: LOVE Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6): Lions D is TE buffet (9 TE TDs allowed); strong volume matchup.
items.why: DET allows high TE fantasy points and TDs; Kraft in good role.

items.text: LOVE volume RBs Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12) for big workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Consistent volume + defenses carved by RBs; Hubbard steady.

items.text: HATE Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32): 90% outside targets likely shadowed by Gonzalez; limited upside history.
HATE Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D) and Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload Q post-layoff); also Skattebo tough spot pregame.
items.why: Nasty matchups/roles; Jacobs rust; Skattebo HOU D.
items.conflict: Jacobs activated/expected counters some hate; Skattebo produced anyway.
